data.final_table_comment: Final feature table built by final_features from 3 feature-selection run(s) sharing target='up_5pct_5day' and setup [lookback_d=1, horizon_h=5, normalize=none, feature_normalize=not_set, corr_threshold=0.9, n_splits=5, min_train=500, random_state=18, selector_class=FeatureSelector, methods=permutation, spearman, xgb_shap, design_dtype=float64, env_fingerprint=cf51e65b3a15]. Shortlist fingerprint: 0c04fa8e679c over 133 channels. 133 channels from 3 pool(s). Selection layer 1: ⚠️ a UNION of per-pool runs, NOT a consensus - a channel offered to one run could never be a candidate in another, so agreement was not available to measure (.claude/context/final_features.md section 6). Run evidence: cleared_p95_not_a_pass=3. ⚠️ CHANNELS=ALL: every numeric channel of each pool whose selection run is in the plan - the selection decided WHICH POOLS, not the width inside one. Source runs: 2026-09-17_103124__mbb__event_features__up_5pct_5day; 2026-09-17_103447__mbb__market_context__up_5pct_5day; 2026-09-17_103605__mbb__market_breadth__up_5pct_5day
